_comment: Registry of every expand-contract migration pair that must have a passing rollback rehearsal before release. Each entry is checked by the CI gate (scripts/check-rollback-coverage.mjs). Add a new entry here whenever a new expand migration is merged; the gate will fail until a matching rehearsal test exists.

expandContractPairs.notes: Sync trigger keeps both columns consistent during the mixed-version window. Contract phase is gated and irreversible at the data layer but down() restores the column from read_at.

workerCompatibilityMatrix.description: sorobanWriteReplayProcessor drains soroban_write_queue; must tolerate a rollback that removes queue rows written by the new schema version
adaptiveScheduler reads/writes indexer_scheduler_state; rollback to previous schema must not corrupt the scheduler_mode enum
webhookRetryProcessor moves exhausted retries to dead-letter queue; rollback must not leave orphaned rows
